title: October 21, 1943: a provisional government was announced in Singapore, with eleven ministers and no territory to govern yet.

sources.text: Drishti IAS - Azad Hind Formation Anniversary
The Tribune - Govt to mark 75 yrs of Bose's Azad Hind govt

caption:
October 21, 1943: a provisional government was announced in Singapore, with eleven ministers and no territory to govern yet.

Formed as part of India's freedom movement, it operated as a government-in-exile structure during the final years of British colonial rule.

The commemoration marked the only time in India's modern history that the national flag was raised at that site on a date other than August 15, underscoring the formation's place in the institutional memory of the freedom movement.

A government structured with ministers and representatives before a single day of formal independence showed that institutional planning for self-rule was underway years before 1947 arrived.
